title: Creation
summary: The act of bringing existence into being by God.
description: Creation represents the beginning of the ordered universe and establishes God as Creator.

title: Beginning
summary: The origin or first point of something.
description: Beginning establishes a starting point for history, creation, and purpose.

title: Light
summary: Represents illumination, life, revelation, and divine order.
description: Throughout Scripture light becomes a recurring symbol connected to God, truth, and life.

title: Word
summary: God's self-expression through speech and Logos.
description: The Word connects divine communication, creation, and revelation.

title: Order
summary: The structured arrangement established during creation.
description: Order contrasts with chaos and becomes a recurring biblical pattern.

title: Life
description: Life is both physical and spiritual throughout Scripture.

title: Truth
summary: That which corresponds to God's character and reality.
description: Truth becomes increasingly important throughout the New Testament.

title: Time
summary: The ordered progression of creation and history.
description: Time provides the framework in which biblical events unfold.
